name: PLSC 3081
title: Summer Internship Experience
description: Provides opportunity for students to gain practical experience, knowledge, and professional skills in a work environment related to employment and careers in plant science or landscape architecture. Students work with instructor and internship supervisor to develop a learning contract and plan of work to ensure meaningful and educational tasks and experiences. Formerly offered as SPSS 3081. May be repeated for credit.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
